### Source: doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_001
**Platinum Reserve Account: Enterprise Business Savings Overview**

## What you earn
- Annual Percentage Yield: 5.0% with daily compounding

## Balance requirements
- Minimum to open and maintain the account: $100,000

## Who this account serves
Designed for enterprises that prioritize capital preservation, liquidity visibility, and operational efficiency while keeping surplus cash productive.

## What you can expect
- Daily interest compounding aligned to your actual ledger balance
- A comprehensive liquidity dashboard for real-time visibility across funds
- Same-day transfer capabilities for rapid movement of funds
- Dedicated account management for onboarding, optimization, and ongoing support

## How to get started
- Confirm you can meet the ongoing balance threshold of $100,000
- Prepare your treasury team’s access needs and governance model ahead of onboarding
- Align internal cash management policies with a daily-compounding savings framework

---

### Source: doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_002
**Platinum Reserve Account: Daily Interest Compounding Explained**

## How daily compounding works
- Interest is calculated using a daily periodic rate derived from 5.0%
- The daily periodic rate is applied to your end-of-day ledger balance
- Earned interest is added to principal each day, so subsequent days earn interest on a growing balance

## Practical implications for treasury
- Earlier deposits and fewer idle intervals can increase effective earnings under daily compounding
- Large intra-day withdrawals reduce the principal used for that day’s accrual

## Interaction with fees
- The monthly maintenance fee of $50.00 reduces the available balance when assessed, which can modestly lower subsequent daily accruals until offset by additional interest or deposits

## Verification and reporting
- You can validate accruals by comparing the daily rate derived from 5.0% to your posted end-of-day balances
- Use period-end statements to reconcile total interest credited against daily changes in principal

## Optimization tips
- Maintain stable balances to maximize the effect of compounding
- Schedule predictable disbursements to minimize reductions in end-of-day balances
- Review the impact of $50.00 in your monthly yield analysis

### Source: doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_003
**Platinum Reserve Account: Using the Liquidity Reporting Dashboard**

## Access and navigation
- Sign in and open the liquidity dashboard from your main navigation
- Use the global filters to refine by account, entity, or classification

## Data freshness
- The dashboard refreshes approximately every 32 minutes
- A status indicator shows when the latest refresh completed

## Historical coverage
- You can review historical liquidity trends for up to 24 months
- Apply consistent filters when comparing different periods to ensure apples-to-apples insights

## Working with views
- Create and save custom filter sets for recurring reviews
- Pin key metrics to the top of your view for faster oversight

## Reconciliation workflow
- Compare dashboard balances to statement snapshots for the same date range
- Investigate variances by drilling into transaction-level detail within the filtered view

## Troubleshooting
- If data appears stale, confirm the last refresh time and reapply filters
- For missing history within the 24-month window, verify entity or account scoping in your saved view

### Source: doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_004
**Platinum Reserve Account: Eligibility Requirements for Enterprises**

## Balance thresholds
- Minimum balance to open and maintain the account: $100,000
- Minimum daily balance to waive the monthly maintenance fee: $250,000

## Organizational readiness
- Ensure treasury policies support ongoing maintenance of balances at or above $100,000
- Establish governance for who can initiate, approve, and audit activity

## Documentation and review
- Prepare standard corporate documentation and authorized signer details
- Ensure internal controls for liquidity oversight are documented before onboarding

## Maintaining eligibility
- Monitor daily balances and set alerts to avoid dipping below $100,000
- If pursuing a fee waiver strategy, maintain an operating buffer above $250,000
- Periodically review cash forecasts to align inflows and outflows with required thresholds

---

### Source: doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_005
**Platinum Reserve Account: Advanced Cash Flow Analytics and Reporting**

## Analytics workspace
- Build consolidated views of inflows and outflows using configurable categories and tags
- Use attribution filters to isolate drivers of variance across periods

## Custom report exports
- Export up to 30 custom liquidity reports per month
- Save report templates with predefined filters to streamline recurring analysis
- Include metadata and category mappings in each export for easier downstream reconciliation

## API access to dashboard data
- Availability: Yes
- Request access by submitting an API access request from your administrative settings
- Generate credentials, store them securely, and limit scope to the minimum required datasets
- Use separate credentials for non-production and production to support safe change management
- Rotate credentials on a regular schedule and revoke unused tokens promptly

## Data governance guidance
- Align exported data and API usage with your internal retention and privacy policies
- Validate report totals against the dashboard before distribution to stakeholders

### Source: doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_006
**Platinum Reserve Account: Integration with Enterprise Treasury Tools**

## Integration patterns supported
- Direct file exchange with structured layouts for balances and transactions
- API-based connections for near-real-time synchronization with treasury workstations and ERPs
- Secure upload workflows for manual updates when automation is not yet in place

## Implementation support
- You are assigned 2 dedicated relationship managers who coordinate technical scoping, timelines, and stakeholder alignment
- Expect guided mapping of data fields to your internal chart of accounts and liquidity taxonomy

## Testing and validation
- Establish a controlled test cycle that mirrors production workflows
- Validate record counts, amounts, and categorizations against source data before promoting changes

## Ongoing change management
- Maintain a documented runbook for integration dependencies and escalation paths
- Schedule periodic reviews with your assigned managers to assess performance and adjust mappings as your treasury model evolves

### Source: doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_007
**Platinum Reserve Account: Same-day transfers and wire capabilities**

## Same-day ACH
- Availability: Yes
- Use for time-sensitive disbursements that require rapid settlement within the banking day
- Confirm recipient details and approval routing before submission to avoid returns

## Wire transfers
- Outgoing domestic wire transfer fee: $0
- Suitable for high-value, time-critical payments where finality is essential
- Verify beneficiary instructions carefully and maintain dual approval for risk control

## External bank transfers
- Processing time for external bank transfers: 0 business days
- Schedule transfers earlier in the day to align with cutoff windows and improve posting certainty

## Operational recommendations
- Maintain updated recipient libraries to reduce entry errors
- Use payment notes to facilitate downstream reconciliation

---

### Source: doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_008
**Platinum Reserve Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits**

## Mobile check deposit limits
- Daily mobile deposit limit: $25,000
- Review remaining daily capacity before submitting additional deposits to avoid holds or rejections

## Outgoing transfer limits
- Maximum daily transfer amount: $100,000
- For larger disbursements, plan multiple approvals and schedule transfers to remain within this threshold

## Best practices to stay within limits
- Monitor limit usage throughout the day and consolidate smaller items where appropriate
- Use descriptive memos to simplify reconciliation when splitting payments across days
- Establish internal approval gates that align with your daily thresholds

## Troubleshooting
- If a deposit or transfer is rejected, check current limit usage and resubmit after adjusting amounts or timing
- Maintain clear documentation for any split transactions to support audit trails

### Source: doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_009
**Platinum Reserve Account: Managing authorized users**

## Access model
- Define roles for initiators, approvers, and viewers based on segregation-of-duties principles
- Scope permissions to the minimum necessary accounts and actions for each user

## Adding and removing users
- Add users from your administrative settings and assign roles during onboarding
- Remove access promptly when responsibilities change or a user departs
- Review permissions alongside role changes to prevent privilege creep

## User limits
- Maximum number of authorized users: 10
- Plan role assignments with this ceiling in mind, prioritizing shared operational mailboxes where appropriate

## Oversight and audit
- Conduct periodic access reviews and require attestations for high-privilege roles
- Use activity logs to verify that approvals and sensitive actions match your policy

### Source: doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_010
**Platinum Reserve Account: Business Credit Card APY Bonuses**

## Eligible Business Credit Cards and APY Bonuses

Holding an eligible Rho-Bank Business Rewards Card can increase the APY on your Platinum Reserve Account. The increase is additive to your current APY and is reflected in your displayed rate and daily interest accruals.

- Business Silver Rewards Card: adds 0.25% to your APY
- Business Gold Rewards Card: adds 0.5% to your APY
- Business Platinum Rewards Card: adds 0.8% to your APY

## How the APY Bonus Is Applied

- The bonus is added as a fixed number of percentage points to your Platinum Reserve Account’s APY based on your eligible card tier.
- The bonus is included in your total APY and affects interest that accrues daily and credits on your normal interest crediting schedule.
- The bonus applies only for the period during which you are eligible; if eligibility begins or ends mid-cycle, the APY used for daily accruals adjusts as of the effective date of that change.

## Verifying Your Bonus

- Check the APY shown in your Platinum Reserve Account details; the increase from your eligible card will be included in the displayed APY.
- Your interest activity will reflect the higher daily accrual associated with the bonus.
- If you hold more than one eligible card or have recently changed cards, contact your Rho-Bank representative to confirm which bonus is currently applied.

## Maintaining Eligibility

To keep the APY bonus active:
- Ensure the eligible Business Rewards Card remains active and in good standing.
- Keep the card associated with the same business entity that owns the Platinum Reserve Account.
- Notify Rho-Bank promptly if your business ownership structure or card status changes, so your APY can be updated accordingly.

## Starting, Changing, or Removing a Bonus

- New or upgraded card: Once eligibility is confirmed, your APY will reflect the applicable bonus going forward.
- Card downgrade, closure, or ineligibility: The APY bonus will no longer apply from the effective date of the change.
- Multiple cards: If your organization holds multiple eligible cards, your account will reflect the applicable bonus for your configuration; contact your Rho-Bank representative if you need confirmation.

## Example (for illustration only)

- If your Platinum Reserve Account APY is 3.00% and you hold a Business Platinum Rewards Card, your APY would increase by 0.8% to 3.80%.
- If your APY is 2.75% and you hold a Business Gold Rewards Card, your APY would increase by 0.5% to 3.25%.
- If your APY is 2.25% and you hold a Business Silver Rewards Card, your APY would increase by 0.25% to 2.50%.
